observation.command:
cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web
REAL=$(sed -n 's/.*"AuthCookie": "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' appsettings.json)
echo "Using REAL admin cookie (len=${#REAL})"
echo "=== 1. Root page with REAL admin cookie: full admin UI? ==="
curl -s -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$REAL" "http://localhost:5195/" -o /tmp/f_root.html
grep -o -E "Bovis Bohrsäulenvisualisierung|nav-item|Liste der Dienste|Administrationsrechten" /tmp/f_root.html | sort -u
echo "=== 2. /app with REAL admin cookie ==="
curl -s -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$REAL" "http://localhost:5195/app" -o /tmp/f_app.html
grep -o -E "Bovis Bohrsäulenvisualisierung|nav-item|Liste der Dienste|nothing at this address" /tmp/f_app.html | sort -u
echo "=== 3. Login page (no auth) ==="
curl -s "http://localhost:5195/login" | grep -o -E "Anmeldung|Anmelden" | sort -u
echo "=== 4. /render endpoint (public API) behavior ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "render(no sid): HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:5195/render"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "render(sid=new): HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:5195/render?sid=new&format=png"
echo "=== 5. Services currently in config.db ==="
sqlite3 config.db "SELECT path, display_name, content_type FROM files WHERE path LIKE 'services/%';" | head
echo "(count: $(sqlite3 config.db "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM files WHERE path LIKE 'services/%';"))"
echo "=== 6. bovis/hello (public health) ==="
curl -s -w " -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:5195/bovis/hello"
